advancements.name: Increase Character Traits
advancements.description: Choose two unmarked character traits and gain a permanent +1 bonus to them. You can't increase these stats again until the next tier.

advancements.name: Add Hit Point Slots
advancements.description: Permanently add 1 or more Hit Point slots.

advancements.name: Add Stress Slots
advancements.description: Permanently add 1 or more Stress slots.

advancements.name: Increase Experience
advancements.description: Choose two Experiences and gain a permanent +1 bonus to both.

advancements.name: Additional Domain Card
advancements.description: Choose an additional domain card at or below your level for your class's domains. If multiclassed, select a card at or below half your level from your multiclass domain.

advancements.name: Increase Evasion
advancements.description: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion.

advancements.name: Upgraded Subclass Card
advancements.description: Take the next card for your subclass — specialization if you only have the foundation, mastery if you have specialization. Crosses out this tier's multiclass option.

advancements.name: Increase Proficiency
advancements.description: Fill in one open Proficiency circle and increase your weapon's damage dice by 1. Requires both level-up picks.

advancements.name: Multiclass
advancements.description: Choose an additional class and domain, gain its class feature, and take a foundation subclass card. Crosses out upgraded subclass and other multiclass options. Requires both level-up picks.
